entries.title: I Corinthians 14:1
segments: Hotly pursue this love, yet seek earnestly spiritual gifts, and chiefly that you may prophesy.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:2
segments: For he who speaks in a "tongue" speaks not to man but to God, for no one understands him, but in the Spirit he utters secret truths.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:3
segments: But he who prophesies addresses words to men that build up, encourage, and console.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:4
segments: He who speaks in a tongue upbuilds himself; but he who prophesies upbuilds the church.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:5
segments: Now I should like you all to speak with "tongues"; but I should rather that you prophesied, For he who prophesies is greater than he who speaks with tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may be built up.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:6
segments: Now brothers, if I should come to you speaking with tongues, what should I benefit you, unless I speak to you some revelation, or knowledge, or prophecy, or teaching?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:7
segments: For if lifeless instruments such as the flute or the harp give no distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is fluted or harped?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:8
segments: Or, for example, if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, what soldier will be prepared for battle?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:9
segments: In the same way with you, if you utter unintelligible words with your tongue, how can what you say be understood? You will be speaking to the winds!

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:10
segments: There are, let us say, so many languages in the world, and none without its meaning.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:11
segments: If then I do not know the force of expression, I shall seem a barbarian to the one who uses it, and he will seem a barbarian to me.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:12
segments: So also in your case, since you are ambitious for spiritual gifts, seek to excel in them for the upbuilding of the church.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:13
segments: So let him who speaks with tongues pray that he may interpret.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:14
segments: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is barren.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:15
segments: What then? I will pray with my spirit, and I will pray also with my mind. I will praise God with my spirit, but I will praise him with my mind, also.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:16
segments: For if you in your spirit bless God, how shall he who fills the place of the unlearned say the Amen to your thanksgiving, when he does not know what you are talking about?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:17
segments: You on the one hand offer a good thanksgiving, but the other is not built up.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:18
segments: Thank God I speak with tongues more than you all,

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:19
segments: but in the church I would rather speak five words with my understanding, so as to instruct others, than ten thousand in an unknown tongue.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:20
segments: Brothers, do not become children in understanding; be babes in malice, but in understanding become mature men.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:21
segments: In the Law it is written. With men of other tongues, and by the lips of strangers, will I speak to this people, and even then they will not listen to me, says the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:22
segments: So then the gift of tongues is for a sign, not to believers, but to unbelievers; but prophecy is not for unbelievers, but for those who believe.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:23
segments: Accordingly, when the whole church assemblies, and everybody is speaking "with tongues," if there enter men unlearned or unbelieving, will they not say that you are mad?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:24
segments: But if all are prophesying when an unlearned or unbelieving man enters, he is convicted in conscience by your speaker, he feels himself judged by all,

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:25
segments: and the secret depths of his heart are laid open. So he will fall upon his face and worship God, saying, "Of a truth, God is with you."

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:26
segments: What follows, then, brothers? Whenever you meet together, each contributes something; a psalm, a sermon, a revelation, a tongue, an interpretation. Let all be done for edification.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:27
segments: If any one speaks in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that in turn, and let some one interpret.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:28
segments: But if there is no one to interpret, let them keep silence in the church, and speak to themselves and to God.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:29
segments: Let the prophets speak by two or three, and let the others exercise their judgment.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:30
segments: But if to one as he sits there some revelation is made, let the first be silent.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:31
segments: For you can all prophesy one by one; so that all may be learning, and all may be encouraged.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:32
segments: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets,

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:33
segments: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace. This custom prevails in all the churches of the saints.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:34
segments: "In your congregation" [you write], "as in all the churches of the saints, let the women keep silence in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak. On the contrary let them be subordinate, as also says the law.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:35
segments: And if they want to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a women to speak in church."

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:36
segments: What, was it from you that the word of God went forth, or to you only did it come?

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:37
segments: If any one thinks himself a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize that what I am now writing you is a command of the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:38
segments: But if any one disregard it he will be disregarded.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:39
segments: So, my brothers, be ambitious for the gift of prophecy, and speak not against the gifts of tongues.

entries.title: I Corinthians 14:40
segments: Let everything be done decently and in order.
